description: 70s groovy retro general presentation template: cream paper, burnt orange, mustard and avocado over chocolate ink; wavy SVG stripe bands, rounded blob cards, mustard sunburst accents, a vinyl-record SVG visual moment, and big rounded display type from the system rounded stack (fully offline). Cover, agenda, big statement, three blob cards, two-column spotlight, stat discs, quote card, SVG visual moment, offline video slot, and closing — with the A−/100%/A+ font control. No gradients, no lesson timeline: built as a general Canva substitute.
fonts: Arial Rounded MT Bold / Helvetica Rounded / ui-rounded (display, system rounded stack — offline)
name: Groove
